description: Designed by scripts/director.py design (seed 31): the roles, ages, styles and colours were dealt by code, the rooms written from the picture of the wallpaper by a model; each slot carries its own kit. Re-shoot under a NEW set name.

kit.name: Birch daybed and wavy oval rug
kit.subject: a calm biophilic bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a low birch toddler daybed and a round oak wall shelf
kit.room: A bright room with a pale ash floor and warm greige walls.
kit.floor: An oval wool rug with wavy edges holds wax crayons in a wooden cup, an open drawing book and a small wooden car.
kit.side_wall: a low natural birch toddler daybed, 140 by 70 cm, with checkered and striped bolster pillows, a small potted fern on the floor beside it and a round oak shelf with two picture books
kit.light: Crisp morning daylight from a window on the {side} falls in clear patches on the floor.
kit.palette: warm greige, pale birch, soft sage, oat, bouclé cream and white
kit.items: daybed, bolster pillows, round shelf, potted fern, oval rug, crayon cup, drawing book, wooden car, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: wax crayons in a wooden cup with an open drawing book on the rug

kit.name: Sand quilted mat and birch ledge
kit.subject: a warm boho nursery for a baby under 2, with a circular quilted play mat and a low birch book ledge
kit.room: A soft nursery with a terracotta tile floor and sand-coloured walls.
kit.floor: A rust-striped cotton dhurrie lies on the tiles, with two cloth baby books and a wooden teething ring on the quilted mat.
kit.side_wall: a circular quilted organic cotton mat with wooden sensory blocks, a low birch book ledge 35 cm high with cloth books, and a small round ceramic vase with dried grasses
kit.light: Soft afternoon light from a window on the {side} lies in warm patches on the tiles.
kit.palette: soft sand, terracotta, warm brown, muted green, cream and birch
kit.items: quilted mat, sensory blocks, book ledge, dhurrie rug, cloth books, teething ring, ceramic vase, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: two cloth baby books and a wooden teething ring lying on the quilted play mat on the floor
